cues.text: Outside the dorm, at the foot of its front steps, Fuuka crouches in front of a dog with her hand held out, and Yukari stands watching. You walk up behind them with your school bag on your shoulder.
The dog lifts a paw and sets it in Fuuka's hand.
The dog gets up and trots over to you. You crouch and hold out your hand, and it sniffs it. You pat the dog's head.
A woman walks up behind Yukari and Fuuka and looks at the dog. They turn to her. As she talks, Yukari folds her arms and Fuuka holds a hand to her chest.
The woman hurries off. Yukari goes over to Koromaru, crouches in front of him and pets him.
